-- ATI formula approach - compute per-trader then average by type
WITH joined AS (
    SELECT 
        t."typeFlag",
        tc.vol_day,
        CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(jsonb_extract_path_text(t.trader_fin_data, 'usd_bal'), '$', ''), ',', '') AS numeric) as usd_bal,
        jsonb_extract_path(tc.trade_perf, 'lev_ratio')::real as lev_ratio,
        jsonb_extract_path(ob.order_metrics, 'mod_freq')::real as mod_freq,
        jsonb_extract_path(ob.order_metrics, 'cancel_pct')::real as cancel_pct,
        jsonb_extract_path(rc.compliance_data, 'prev_viol')::int as prev_viol,
        jsonb_extract_path_text(rc.compliance_data, 'comp_rate') as comp_rate,
        CAST(jsonb_extract_path_text(t.trader_fin_data, 'age_days') AS int) as age_days
    FROM traders t
    JOIN trade_records tc ON tc.tr_anchor = t."TR_KEY"
    JOIN order_behaviour ob ON tc."REC_KEY" = ob."REC_NODE"
    JOIN reg_compliance rc ON tc."REC_KEY" = rc."REC_COMP"
),
scores AS (
    SELECT 
        LOWER("typeFlag") as trader_type,
        -- ATI = DTR * TLE * OMI
        CASE 
            WHEN usd_bal > 0 AND lev_ratio IS NOT NULL AND mod_freq IS NOT NULL AND cancel_pct IS NOT NULL AND cancel_pct < 1 
            THEN (vol_day / usd_bal) * lev_ratio * (mod_freq / (1 - cancel_pct))
            ELSE NULL 
        END as ati,
        -- CHS = 1 / (1 + CRS * comp_rate_numeric)
        CASE 
            WHEN prev_viol IS NOT NULL AND comp_rate IS NOT NULL AND age_days IS NOT NULL
            THEN 1.0 / (1.0 + (prev_viol::numeric / GREATEST(1, age_days::numeric / 365)) * 
                CASE comp_rate 
                    WHEN 'A' THEN 1 
                    WHEN 'B' THEN 2 
                    WHEN 'C' THEN 3 
                    WHEN 'D' THEN 4 
                    ELSE 0 
                END)
            ELSE NULL 
        END as chs
    FROM joined
)
SELECT trader_type,
       ROUND(AVG(ati)::numeric, 4) as avg_aggression_score,
       ROUND(AVG(chs)::numeric, 4) as avg_compliance_score
FROM scores
GROUP BY trader_type
ORDER BY avg_aggression_score DESC;
